about.title: A Legacy of Innovation and Excellence
about.text1: Founded with a vision to nurture thinkers, innovators, and leaders, BAC University stands at the forefront of global education. Our state-of-the-art research facilities, world-class faculty, and industry-connected programs empower students to solve real-world problems and shape the future.
about.text2: Through comprehensive academic training, robust student mentorship, and intensive placement training, BAC has consistently driven excellence. We believe in providing an environment that fosters intellectual curiosity and supports diverse, impactful discovery.

footer.ctaDescription: Join 20,000+ students who chose BAC to launch their careers, startups, and research journeys. Your story starts here.
footer.aboutText: BAC Global University is a globally connected research university preparing 20,000+ students for careers, entrepreneurship, research, and leadership through world-class education across 8 schools and 200+ programs.

departments.name: Computer Science & Engineering
departments.description: A globally recognised program blending theory, systems, and software craftsmanship with industry-aligned capstones.
departments.longDescription: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering at BAC is a top-ranked research and teaching unit, internationally recognised for its work in distributed systems, programming languages, and human-centred computing. Students engage with a curriculum co-designed with industry partners, participate in flagship hackathons, and ship production software before they graduate. Our graduates lead engineering teams at the world's most respected technology companies and have founded venture-backed startups across three continents.
departments.vision: To be the world's most respected computer science department for human-centred, systems-driven, and impact-focused computing education.
departments.mission: To educate engineers who build reliable, secure, and humane software systems; to advance the science of computing through curiosity-driven research; and to translate discoveries into products, policy, and pedagogy that uplift society.

departments.name: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
departments.description: An interdisciplinary powerhouse shaping the next generation of AI researchers, ML engineers, and data leaders.
departments.longDescription: The Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science is BAC's flagship response to the most consequential technology shift of our era. We bring together computer science, statistics, neuroscience, and ethics to train graduates who can build, deploy, and govern AI systems at scale. The department hosts four research centres, three industry-sponsored labs, and a vibrant community of 1,800 students working on real-world AI problems with partners including Google DeepMind, Microsoft Research, and the Alan Turing Institute.

departments.mission: To train AI practitioners and researchers who can design intelligent systems responsibly, govern their societal impact, and advance the frontiers of machine intelligence.

departments.longDescription: The Department of Biotechnology at BAC integrates biology, engineering, and data science to address the grand challenges of human health, agriculture, and sustainability.
